description_en: Provides the method and steps to obtain an HTTP link for accessing a container
description_zh: 提供获取容器访问HTTP链接的方法和步骤
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc get-web-terminal --job-id dlc-20210126170216-000000 --pod-id dlc-20210126170216-0000-chief-0 --pod-uid 94a7cc7c-0033-48b5-85bd-71c63592c268 --is-shared true --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetWebTerminal

parameters.help_en: The pod ID of the job
parameters.name: pod_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create a shared link for accessing the container. Valid values:
true: Returns a shared link for accessing the container. The link expires after 30 seconds and can be used only once. After someone accesses the container through this link, subsequent requests using the same link are invalid.
false: Returns a regular link for accessing the container. Alibaba Cloud identity authentication is required when using this link. The link expires after 30 seconds
parameters.help_zh:
是否创建用于分享的进入容器链接，取值如下：
true：返回进入容器的分享链接。该链接将在三十秒后失效，且仅能被使用一次。一旦通过该链接进入容器后，其他使用该链接进入容器的请求将无效。
false：返回普通的进入容器的分享链接，使用时需进行阿里云身份认证。该链接将在三十秒后失效
parameters.name: is_shared

RequestId.description_en: The request ID for this call, used for diagnostics and troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 此次调用的请求ID，用于诊断和答疑
